objective: Matched common corpus including original LED videos and ruler corpus: six dense RGB variants, physical geometry baseline, two query-extended frozen PCA residual baselines.

arms.partial: Decoder, last quarter of encoder blocks (DINO 3 / I-JEPA 8), final encoder normalization

fairness: Same common scenes, grouped split, P1 teachers and fixed LED calibration for all learned methods.
Same 60 epoch cap, patience 10, seed 4242, effective batch16, validation-only stopping and fixed loss family.

Six dense variants share decoder initialization and augmentation. Residual baselines retain frozen backbone, PCA128, MLP 64/32 and gate0.25, extended with physical query features for dense prediction.
Physical and residual methods receive oracle geometry; direct RGB models do not. Report this input advantage explicitly.
All checkpoints frozen before diagnostic test; previously inspected video holdouts are not a new blind evaluation.

teacher.amplitude_remapping: Recomputed consistently from the refined no-ruler FEM profile; not a new LED fit.
teacher.geometry: Previous mask-to-planar-registration heuristic; 17 x 1.7 cm ruler, fixed coil; hand, RF discharge, depth and 3D not modelled.

training.precision: BF16 on supported GPU, otherwise FP16 with scaler
training.sampling: 50% ruler / 50% no-ruler; equal camera/source, then equal video/scene group within condition, then equal frames; shared deterministic order across RGB methods and physical sampled-query baseline.
training.loss: Unmodified v1 calibrated-potential, normalized-phi and gradient losses
training.selection: 0.5 real-validation air MAE + 0.5 real-validation affected-air MAE, group-equal means

augmentation.seed: SHA256(seed, epoch, image id); identical across arms
augmentation.teacher_pairing: Same geometric warp for RGB, phi, phi0, valid, air, ruler. Normalized convolution; invalid/padded pixels excluded. Photometric changes RGB only. No object rearrangement, mosaic or cut-paste.

evaluation.test: Freeze all six checkpoints before one diagnostic test pass; no model selection or retraining afterward
evaluation.prospective: A new camera recording remains necessary; these reserved videos were inspected in earlier trials.
metrics: temporal stability on a new video, later

limitations: FEM-derived targets are approximate, not independently measured voltage ground truth.
Original LED calibration transfer to the grounded-ruler scene is an assumption; source and low-amplitude voltage extension are extrapolated.
Adjacent frames add observations, not independent capture sessions.
Full adjustment may overfit; no improvement is guaranteed.
release_policy: Separate v3 experiment only. No app, manuscript, previous weight or release changes. No shutdown scheduled.
sampling: 50% ruler / 50% no-ruler; equal camera/source, then equal video/scene group within condition, then equal frames; shared deterministic order across RGB methods and physical sampled-query baseline.

legacy_extension.input: Frozen official encoder pooled features -> train-only PCA128 + 16 physical query features
legacy_extension.head: MLP (144->64 LayerNorm SiLU Dropout0.2 ->32 SiLU ->1), query evaluated on 112x112 grid, bilinear residual to448
legacy_extension.output: clamp(new physical baseline phi + 0.25*tanh(residual),0,1), conductor boundary values restored, same LED LUT
legacy_extension.claim: Query-conditioned extension of legacy scalar architecture, not unchanged original scalar weights.
